text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In today's race, Chan-me will rise again like a phoenix.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With a dramatic victory, Chan-chan becomes
a symbol of revival. And Chan-chan dolls
become wildly popular all across Japan...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We need to increase production
of the Mar-chan Dolls... don't we!"
